answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 25282 Country: India Title: My question is , i saw at many places peoples organise singing nazam nats and reciting quran etc on thursday to inspire the peoples for donaiting money in mosque madarsa etc . is it right or ok according to shariat? . if is it ok then why only thursday why not other?. can we organise such types of peogramme for thursday or other day? Question: ASSLAMU ALAIKUM Hazrat , my question is , i saw at many places peoples organise singing nazam nats and reciting quran etc on thursday to inspire the peoples for donaiting money in mosque madarsa etc . is it right or ok according to shariat? . if is it ok then why only thursday why not other?. can we organise such types of peogramme for thursday or other day? please guide me WSSALAM Answer ID: 25282 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1517/1149/D=1431) In order to collect donations for mosque, neither it is necessary to recite naat nor the day of Thursday. Even, if by reciting the poems people are disturbed or it causes any other kinds of concern, then it is not right to recite it. However, people should send the amount keeping in view the need of the mosque, which sometime is wajib. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
